status_summary: No bill authorizing humane disposal of excess wild horses and burros was found. The fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027 budget requests omitted the long-standing appropriations language barring sale for slaughter, per news reports of 2025-06-03 and 2026-09-02, but Congress kept the restriction in the final fiscal 2026 law and the House committee's fiscal 2027 bill retains a bar on destroying animals for commercial products. BLM estimates 85,466 animals on its lands as of 2026-03-01 and 58,025 held off the range as of May 2026, and reports 7,853 removals and 8,080 placements into private care in fiscal 2025.

timeline.event: Reporting said the fiscal 2026 BLM budget request omitted the appropriations language barring sale or transfer of wild horses and burros for slaughter.
BLM estimated 85,466 wild horses and burros on its managed lands (fiscal 2026 estimate).

Reporting said the fiscal 2027 budget request again omitted the slaughter restriction, that Congress kept it in the final fiscal 2026 law, and that the House Appropriations Committee's fiscal 2027 Interior bill retains the bar on destroying excess animals for commercial products.

title: Seek law allowing humane disposal of excess wild horses and burros
